summary: The row of tabs across the top of the browser window.
description: The container that holds and manages all open tabs, tab groups, and split-view wrappers in a browser window. A customized built-in element extending the toolkit <tabs> element (is="tabbrowser-tabs"); handles layout (horizontal/vertical), overflow scrolling, drag and drop, and keyboard navigation across tabs/groups/split views.

attributes.name: orient
attributes.description: The only observedAttribute; "horizontal" or "vertical" tab layout. Backs the verticalMode getter and is propagated to the pinned-tabs container.

attributes.name: overflow
attributes.description: Reflected state attribute set when the tabstrip's scrollbox is overflowing; not meant to be set by a consumer.

attributes.name: closebuttons
attributes.description: Controls close-button visibility policy, e.g. "activetab" shows the close button only on the active tab.

attributes.name: expanded
attributes.description: Reflected state for the vertical-tabs sidebar expanded/collapsed layout.

attributes.name: tablist-has-focus
attributes.description: Internal accessibility-focus bookkeeping, backed by the tablistHasFocus getter/setter.

attributes.name: movingtab
attributes.description: Internal state set while a tab drag is in progress.

attributes.name: using-closing-tabs-spacer
attributes.description: Internal state used while a closing-tab width-preserving spacer is active.

attributes.name: hiddensoundplaying
attributes.description: Internal state reflecting whether a hidden tab is currently playing audio.

events.name: TabAnimationEnd
events.description: Bubbling CustomEvent dispatched by this component on a tab element once its open/close max-width transition finishes.

events.name: SplitViewCreated
events.description: Bubbling CustomEvent dispatched on this element by tabbrowser.js (gBrowser) when a split view is created; listened for here to react to layout changes, not dispatched by tabs.js itself.

events.name: SplitViewRemoved
events.description: Bubbling CustomEvent dispatched on this element by tabbrowser.js when a split view is removed.

events.name: TabGroupCreate
events.description: Dispatched by tabbrowser.js, not this file; listened for here to update tabstrip layout/animation state.

events.name: TabGroupRemoved
events.description: Dispatched by tabbrowser.js, not this file; listened for here.

events.name: TabGroupExpand
events.description: Dispatched elsewhere (tab-group); captured here (capture phase) to mark animating groups before overflow handlers run.

cssProperties.name: --tab-min-width
cssProperties.description: Set dynamically by #updateTabMinWidth() based on density/pref/icon settings.

cssProperties.name: --tab-min-width-pref
cssProperties.description: Minimum tab width sourced from a preference.

cssProperties.name: --tab-min-width-extra-icons
cssProperties.description: Extra min-width reserved when a tab shows extra icons.

cssProperties.name: --tab-min-width-uidensity
cssProperties.description: Minimum tab width adjustment for UI density.

cssProperties.name: --tab-height-with-margin-padding
cssProperties.description: Computed tab height including margin and padding.

cssProperties.name: --tab-vertical-scrollbar-color
cssProperties.description: Scrollbar color in vertical tabs mode.

cssProperties.name: --tab-vertical-block-margin
cssProperties.description: Block margin between tabs in vertical mode.

cssProperties.name: --tab-pinned-container-margin-inline-expanded
cssProperties.description: Margin for the pinned-tabs container when the sidebar is expanded.

cssProperties.name: --tab-pinned-expanded-background-width
cssProperties.description: Background width for pinned tabs when expanded.

cssProperties.name: --tab-pinned-margin-inline-expanded
cssProperties.description: Inline margin for pinned tabs when expanded.

cssProperties.name: --tab-pinned-min-width-expanded
cssProperties.description: Minimum width for pinned tabs when expanded.

cssProperties.name: --tabs-navbar-separator-color
cssProperties.description: Color of the separator between the tabstrip and nav bar.

cssProperties.name: --tabs-navbar-separator-style
cssProperties.description: Style of the separator between the tabstrip and nav bar.
